g.text: A fire map is not a picture of the fire.
It is where the day is assigned and where the way out is written.
So unfinished line is drawn unfinished: solid holds, dashed does not.
LCES is on this sheet, or it does not exist.
Divisions are lettered round the fire from the anchor point,
so a name on the radio is a place on the map.
The fire, the divisions and the points are fictional.
THIS MAP IS A SAFETY DOCUMENT
safety zones - SZ, sized and reachable
a map showing only finished line
tells a crew the fire is caught
drop points, numbered on the road
round the fire from the anchor
marked on the line, A/B and B/Z
the far side, counted the other way
a piece of line with one boss
1:24,000 - it is carried in a pocket
because a GPS needs to agree
S T A N D L
